findings.text: Biggest gain: Start to T1, +0.34 s for LEC L36 over SAI L44. Reaches 21 km/h higher top speed.
Gain #2: T8, +0.25 s for LEC L36 over SAI L44. Carries 3 km/h more minimum speed, gets on the throttle 8 m earlier.
Gain #3: T13, +0.21 s for SAI L44 over LEC L36. No clear difference in the recorded channels.
Gain #4: T10, +0.15 s for LEC L36 over SAI L44. Carries 3 km/h more minimum speed.
Gain #5: T14, +0.15 s for SAI L44 over LEC L36. Brakes 11 m later, carries 3 km/h less minimum speed, exits 10 km/h slower.
